variant.briefing:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a contract from a major client who needs a skilled pilot to move a large load of luxury items from [Location] to [Destination]. 

You'll need room for at least [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers in your hold. You'll also need a handheld tractor beam to get everything loaded and unloaded. 

And as a fair warning, the things you'll be carrying are pricey enough that you might attract some unwanted attention. Be ready to defend yourself if you can't evade.
variant.prerequisiteSummary: Rookie / 50 rep to Master / 237,750 rep; CrimeStat limited to 2 or below; Pyro And Nyx
